atomicity.reason: One obligation (accept only strictly-lower candidates); the closing sentence restates the consequence rather than adding a second obligation.

comprehensibility.reason: The rule is intelligible from the sentence alone; the reader needs no knowledge of how the candidate was derived to apply the clamp.

feasibility.reason: A one-sided comparison and conditional store is trivially implementable and contradicts nothing else stated.

parent_fit.reason: ARCH_SOH_TRACKER owns a monotonic clamp that only accepts a candidate below the currently reported value; this requirement specifies exactly that clamp rule.

unambiguity.reason: 'Strictly below' and 'leave unchanged otherwise' fix the boundary at equality and admit only one reading.

verifiability.reason: The comparison rule is testable, but the reported capacity's value at initialisation is never stated, so the expected outcome for the first candidate after start-up is undefined.
verifiability.suggestion: State the initial reported capacity (e.g. 'on initialisation the reported capacity is the persisted value, or rated capacity when none is stored') so the first-candidate case is testable.

summary: Clean statement of the monotonic clamp ARCH_SOH_TRACKER owns; the initial value of the reported capacity is never established, so the first candidate after initialisation has no defined expected outcome.
